claim: G33 R3: from a fresh evidence-owned runtime root, the revised current ContinuityRNA must cross the R1 discontinuity through one source-grounded local-model reading and reconstruct the exact capsule/trajectory-authorized checkpoint; the same bounded integration experiment then presents a frozen source-grounded relational encounter to the corrected current GroundLanguage/RIntend/RAudit/RDisposition path, records whether an intention-distorting expression is held and what native continuation is actually available, and stops at the first absent current-consumer product without adding or assuming a repair, certification, or effect path.
non_claims: No claim of genuine unseen T-19 wording, general language understanding, completed VoiceRNA repair, certified human emission, quiescence, endogenous development, capability construction, NACE learning, integrated restart, new Mattermost activity, complete G33, or final PoC acceptance. The continuity wording is the disclosed R1 transfer case. The deliberately distorted voice expression is builder-owned synthetic test contact and may prove native discrimination only; it is not represented as an LLM product. A local-model rendering, if separately observed, remains generated and cannot establish authority, fidelity, permission, completion, or effect eligibility.
rationale: G33 R2 repaired and closed the exact-string continuity seam but explicitly deferred the integrated clean-start trace. C-004-C-013 and S-502/S-901 require generated readings to remain subordinate to native source-grounded cognition. S-601-S-607 and S-1201-S-1203 require the next experiment to reach the actual next consumer and preserve a missing continuation as evidence rather than silently composing one in builder code. The corrected SC05/SC07 relational path is the current non-behavior-table voice surface; the older first-match VoicePolicy path cannot be used to make G33 green.
reading: Read both complete controls; Soul specification S-502-S-505, S-601-S-607, S-801-S-804, S-901-S-905, S-1101-S-1105, S-1201-S-1203 and T-19/T-22/T-23/T-31/T-33; ACCEPTANCE G33 and its clean-start runner contract; BUILD_FIDELITY_PROTOCOL F-01-F-07; SC05 relational voice closure, SC07 source-grounded construction closure, SC08 recurring corrected-path closure; G33 R1 failure and G33 R2 closure. Historical voice or continuity PASS labels are not current integrated products.
representation: A new empty G33 runtime root receives copied synthetic trajectory, capsule, memory-object, and scoped registry material solely as rehydration inputs. Current ContinuityRNA creates fresh restart/contact records, obtains one generated and mechanically source-verified local-model relation set, and invokes the unchanged exact capsule/trajectory certificate. The experiment then constructs the corrected current relational language product from frozen human-confirmation nodes, derives RIntend, and gives RAudit both a faithful control and a deliberately intention-distorting expression. RDisposition may expose a repair request, but only an existing native consumer may continue it. Builder JavaScript launches pinned PeTTa, retains bytes, checks hashes, and stops; it may not select an answer, invent a repair, certify an expression, or translate an absent product into progress.
consumer: Actual current consumers are bootstrap_continuity_intent_v1/ContinuityRNA/ContinuityReadingDecision/ProjectContinuityRNA and the capsule/trajectory membranes, followed by bootstrap_relational_voice/GroundLanguage/RIntend/RAudit/RDisposition. The experiment also inspects whether a current native continuation consumes the returned repair-request and reaches independently audited faithful expression. No legacy first-match VoicePolicy selector, candidate-authored procedure, or builder-supplied semantic continuation is permitted.
falsifiers: Continuity again depends on exact sentence dispatch; a model-provided project or checkpoint is accepted; the clean root does not create fresh contact records; the exact answer lacks capsule/trajectory certification; old evidence is copied in as a native result; the distorted expression is accepted as faithful; a builder stage label or JavaScript branch supplies a repaired expression; the old fixed defect/action or clause-selection path is used; an absent repair/certification consumer is hidden; later G33 phases execute after a discontinuity; raw products or resource observations are missing; or any external network, credential, Chroma mutation, Mattermost operation, or external effect occurs.
scope_review: R3 may add only its frozen plan/contract/fixture, integration launcher/verifier, raw G33 R3 evidence, and an outcome or bounded closure. It may read committed controls, current source, prior synthetic G11/G33 inputs, ignored local LM Studio profile, and localhost service health. At most one qwen-local continuity call and one qwen-local relational rendering call are allowed, each with the consumer's committed limit and a 130-second process ceiling. It may not modify core MeTTa/Prolog, controls, historical evidence, local model configuration, live Mattermost/private configuration, credentials, Chroma data, accepted registries, or user-owned G22/G28 work. No OpenRouter or non-local network call is authorized.
rollback: No core, canonical state, credential, Chroma, or external surface mutation is permitted. Failed evidence is retained. Evidence-owned runtime roots are disposable only before commit and otherwise remain provenance. Any missing voice continuation must be repaired under a separately frozen G33 R4 plan; R3 cannot be edited to add that cognition after observing the result.

cases.positive: The disclosed R1 continuity request crosses the repaired current consumer and reaches the identical exact certificate/state from a clean root; the relational voice consumer forms the expected source-grounded intention and accepts a faithful control.
cases.severed: A deliberately intention-distorting expression omits supported retentions and substitutes a system promise; RAudit must not call it faithful, and no builder substitute may satisfy the missing repair/certification continuation.
cases.neutral: Equivalent ordering of the faithful finite clauses preserves the native intended meaning and standing.
cases.restored: Restoring the faithful source-grounded expression restores the faithful native audit without altering the intention or source basis.
cases.held_out: No held-out claim. Both continuity and finite relational fixtures are disclosed transfer/integration inputs frozen before the runner.
cases.unknown_malformed: Provider absence, malformed generated reading, malformed voice expression, or unavailable current continuation remains a differentiated non-authoritative product and stops the experiment.

environment: Pinned native PeTTa commit ae66fa8e41dcd5539d614706bd4e5cfb34f9608d through SWI-Prolog 10.0.2 arm64. LM Studio qwen-local may be used only on 127.0.0.1. Chroma may be health-observed but is not required for exact state and is never mutated. All inputs are synthetic and public-safe.
next_step_hypothesis: If current continuity crosses and corrected relational voice supplies an actual native repair-to-faithful-and-certifiable continuation, R3 may close only those bounded integration claims and the next revision may proceed to quiescence. If, as expected from source inspection, the native audit produces a repair request but no current consumer can form and compare a repaired expression, preserve the R3 failure and freeze G33 R4 around that exact missing constitutive continuation without reviving first-match behavior.
